verdict.rationale: turbopuffer documents upserts, conditional upsert/patch/delete, and patch/delete-by-filter writes, and states that vectors are incrementally indexed in SPFresh with 'writes appear in search results immediately.' Namespace metadata also exposes the count of unindexed write-ahead-log rows, which gives visibility into indexing lag. Missing for 10: an explicit documented consistency model (e.g. strong vs eventual read options and their guarantees for deletes and full-text search), and independent or hands-on corroboration of write-to-query freshness.
